2026.07.05.1.title: CLI Routes and Paper Finder
2026.07.05.1.summary: Adds mature external CLI routes and local paper retrieval workflows.
2026.07.05.1.how_to_apply: Safe skill and script updates can be applied directly. Review local prompt customizations before replacing prompt files.
added: Codex CLI support for paper summarization and enrich workflows.
Agy CLI support for Gemini-family direct CLI workflows.
paper-finder skill for retrieving existing papers from keywords, vague descriptions, authors, tags, and snippets.
Detailed paper-finder mode and no-keyword search flow.

2026.07.05.2.title: PaperHub Utility Updater
2026.07.05.2.summary: Adds versioned update metadata and an updater skill for syncing PaperHub skills and utilities while preserving local configuration and prompt customizations.
2026.07.05.2.how_to_apply: Use update-paperhub-utils. Let the updater replace safe skill and script files, preserve config and paper-library files, and ask before ambiguous prompt or structural merges.
added: update-paperhub-utils skill for adopted PaperHub copies.
utility_manifest.json for update-managed and protected path boundaries.
changed: PaperHub utilities are grouped into update-managed files and user-owned local state.

2026.07.05.3.title: Structured Utility Folders
2026.07.05.3.summary: Physically separates PaperHub utility entry scripts, importable Python modules, prompt fragments, local config, and generated outputs.
2026.07.05.3.how_to_apply: Update local commands and custom docs to use scripts/, paperhub/, prompts/, config/, and output/raw_outputs/. Preserve local config/config.json and config/.env; if an old misc/config.json exists, compare before migrating.
changed: Importable Python modules moved to paperhub_utils/paperhub/.
User config and defaults moved to paperhub_utils/config/.
Raw model outputs moved under paperhub_utils/output/raw_outputs/.
paper-finder CLI now matches the skill flags for explicit terms, result counts, detailed cards, exclude penalties, and full-detail output.
Enrich prepare supports a coding-agent route without changing Agy or Codex settings.

2026.07.05.4.title: Utility Update Boundary Clarification
2026.07.05.4.summary: Clarifies which PaperHub utility folders are replaceable framework code versus user-owned local state.
2026.07.05.4.how_to_apply: Keep user config files in config/ and generated files in output/. Treat scripts/ and paperhub/ as update-managed utility code; review only if the updater reports local edits.
changed: Adds manifest path policy metadata for replaceable utility code, merge-aware prompt defaults, and preserved user config.
Documents the PaperHub utility folder layout so entry scripts, importable utility code, prompts, config, output, and tests have separate roles.
